title: The kb records that a Sonnet 5.5 run was billed 0.20 USD per MTok for cache reads against the documented 0.10
goal: A _conflicts.md entry, through /kb-research, records that a claude -p Sonnet 5.5 probe (BG-rbokisbc, 2026-10-09) was billed cache reads at 0.20 USD per MTok while the pricing page (S2131) and kb/public/agents/agent-caching.md:24 and kb/public/claude/ci-and-headless.md:87 state 0.10 (0.05x input); the entry names the probe's stream evidence and what would settle it (a re-read of the pricing page, a billing statement); bench_core.PRICE keeps 0.10 until it is settled
